notes: Very close reproduction: every element is present, text content is exact, icons, colours, radii and the map/route all match, and the 0.98% diff is essentially at the anti-aliasing floor. Faded year bars and the second route leg show slight non-AA differences. Offsets were estimated by eye from 1440x900 images, so sub-2px figures carry about 1px of uncertainty.
